name: Prompt Optimization Training Set
description: Training set used by the optclosedloop pipeline to drive PromptIter gradient signal. Contains three cases covering two categories: optimizable (baseline fails, patched prompt fixes it) and noeffect (stable pass anchor). The degrade category is intentionally absent from train so the optimiser can only learn from clearly fixable signals.

userTurns.message: What is the capital city of France? Just state the name and cite the source: World Factbook.

ideal.notes: Baseline system prompt is vague and hedges. Tight system_prompt (round 1 patch) should push the model to direct answer + cite.

userTurns.message: Compute five plus three using the calculator.

ideal.notes: Baseline tool description is too vague. Better tool_desc_calc patch fixes argument typing.

userTurns.message: Compute the answer: 6 * 7 using the calculator.

ideal.notes: This case should always pass. It is an anchor used to detect over-fitting on the other two train cases.
